profile_text.body:
Equifax Inc is a public company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, traded under the ticker EFX, with SEC filings under CIK 0000033185. Its website presents it as a credit bureau serving businesses and consumers, offering credit reports and credit scores along with identity protection tools that include daily monitoring and alerts. The site also describes Equifax Complete, which it says monitors the Equifax credit report, provides alerts, and offers recovery help through ID Restoration Specialists for people who become victims of identity theft. Much of the site is educational material about credit reports, credit scores, debt, credit cards, loans, fraud and identity theft, plus a Spanish-language section covering US Equifax credit reports, credit scores and money management.

The site's language is promotional. It describes identity protection and credit monitoring as ways to focus on living your financial best, and frames financial knowledge as a valuable asset when planning for milestones such as buying a home, a car or taking out a loan. The material does not describe any AI products or services.

On the legal side, the company's litigation exposure is recorded in Georgia, with 105 cases. No individual lawsuits are listed.
